symbols.read: Price has bounced to 731.97, rebuilding the buffer above the 722.40 lower pivot and confirming the neutral-to-bearish stance was right to stay uncommitted rather than chase the SELL. The 4H remains bearish and the combined signal holds at HOLD, but the SELL setup at 722.40 (stop 737.02, target 686.36) is still invalidated, so no bearish trigger is live; the 1H trend stays up even as the last bar prints marginally red (729.13→728.68). Levels are unchanged: a close below 722.40 revives the bearish case toward 686.36, while reclaiming 737.02 flips the read toward the 758.44 upper pivot. Invalidation of the neutral-to-bearish bias is a break above 737.02; the change from the prior read is the firmer cushion over the pivot and the absence of open FVGs, which trims immediate downside urgency without flipping the bias.

Price has recovered to 81,652.00 from 81,534.01 but remains below the overhead bearish FVG at 81,886.01–82,050.94, so the bearish-leaning bias is confirmed rather than revised: the 4H stays bearish, the combined read stays SELL, and the 1H trend remains down despite the small bounce. The 81,033.66 trigger is still the key downside level toward 77,715.32, with 82,413.00 the stop. The signal is flagged INVALIDATED and the regime is BULLISH, which weakens conviction on the short side — invalidation of the bearish case is a close back above the FVG zone, and 84,352.00 remains the level that would turn structure outright bullish.

Price has pushed back to 2,397.98, reclaiming the 2,403.69 lower pivot intraday and invalidating the prior bearish read — the level that was resistance is now being tested from below, and the 1H trend's continued drift down (2,387.27→2,384.68) is no longer confirming the pivot rejection. The bearish FVG at 2,402.25–2,410.00 remains the key overhead barrier; a close above it flips the structure constructive toward the 2,579.88 upper pivot, while rejection there re-arms the 2,354.54–2,370.66 shelf and the 2,227.50 target. Bias is now neutral-to-constructive given the pivot reclaim and bullish regime, but the failed SELL signal (stop 2,402.67 already breached) means no fresh short here. Invalidation of the constructive turn is a close back below 2,403.69 that keeps price under the FVG.

The bearish bias is invalidated: price at 104.62 has held above the 104.46–105.22 zone, the 1H trend has flipped up, and the combined read is now HOLD with the regime tagged BULLISH, so the prior SELL no longer stands. The bear gap at 104.91–105.14 is still open directly overhead and remains the immediate test — a push through it confirms the flip, while rejection keeps price pinned in the 104.12–104.91 chop. The 107.16 pivot that previously capped upside is now the lower pivot and the long trigger, with 113.40 the upper pivot above; the old 100.92 target is off the table unless 107.16 fails decisively. Invalidation of this revised lean is a close back below 104.46, which would refill the gap and revive the downside case toward 100.92.

Price has drifted lower to 57.16 from 57.22, extending the bearish move but without a fresh break of any new level, and the combined 4H+1H signal has softened from SELL to HOLD even as the 4H stays bearish and the 1H trend remains down — so the outright bearish bias is now downgraded to neutral-to-bearish rather than confirmed. No open FVGs remain, leaving no support shelf beneath price and keeping 55.37 as the downside objective, while the 58.41 short entry has now expired untriggered, so the drift lower is happening with no live position. The 1H bar is essentially flat (57.12→57.16, +0.07%), signaling stalling momentum rather than fresh selling pressure. Invalidation: a sustained reclaim of 58.41 flips the read bullish toward the 61.45 upper pivot; a clean break below 57.00 would re-assert the bearish case toward 55.37.

Price has stalled just below the 4,141.44 lower pivot at 4,124.35, and the 1H print of +0.08% off 4,120.96 is the first sign of downside momentum flattening — the bearish continuation is intact but no longer accelerating. The bias stays bearish: 4H direction is bearish, the 1H trend is down, and the combined read is HOLD, with 4,065.48 still the active objective and the 4,155.445–4,158.805 bear FVG overhead. The 4,141.44 retest-as-resistance scenario from the prior read remains the key trigger — rejection there keeps the path to 4,065.48 open, while a reclaim of 4,148.48 invalidates the short and neutralizes the downside structure. What changed: price has gone flat rather than extending, so the setup is now a watch-and-hold below 4,141.44 rather than an active continuation.

Bias stays bearish but conviction has weakened: price is still pinned below the 1.31 lower pivot at 1.30, yet the 1H trend has flipped back up (1.29→1.30, +0.22%) and the combined 4H+1H signal has downgraded from SELL to HOLD, so the downside momentum that confirmed the prior read has stalled rather than reversed. The 4H remains bearish and the SELL setup stays invalidated, with 1.31 the immediate level to watch — a sustained reclaim puts the bearish structure back on the shelf and opens 1.43, while rejection keeps 1.20 as the target. No open FVGs means no cushion either way, so the 1.31 line is the whole story. Invalidation of this bearish read: a sustained hold back above 1.31.
